_about: Survey notes and photos for each station, keyed by the station id used in skylink-data.geojson. Clearance notes are design intent for the concept, not measured site conditions. Add photos as { "url": "images/stations/<file>", "caption": "...", "credit": "..." } with the url relative to public/.

stadium.station_type: End terminal with drive machinery and cabin storage
clearance_notes: Platform sits on the upper concourse level, outside the seating bowl sightlines.
Departing cable climbs away from the stand before crossing 17th Street.
Game-day queuing is held at concourse level, below the boarding platform.

wells.station_type: Through station and junction for the 10th Street spur
clearance_notes: Platform is placed on the lower block so cables pass beside, not over, the taller tower.
The spur leaves eastward along the 10th Street corridor to avoid crossing the Arboretum canopy.
Deflection bay turns the Crimson Line toward the IMU inside the station envelope.

imu.station_type: Central transfer hub, two lines on one platform level
clearance_notes: Station frame is set back from the historic limestone parapets and tower.
Limestone-clad enclosure keeps the roofline reading as part of the existing building.
Cross-platform transfer between the Crimson and Limestone lines without changing level.
Approach spans stay clear of the Dunn's Woods canopy to the west.
Rooftop mechanical plant is bridged by the platform deck, not relocated.
Arriving cable crosses Third Street with clearance for buses and service vehicles.
Terminal return wheel is housed within the roof frame, back from the Atwater Avenue frontage.
Shortest host building on the network; the platform deck is raised on the station frame to hold cable clearance over Eagleson Avenue.
Alignment follows the building's long axis to keep clear of the Wells Library spur.

eigenmann.station_type: End terminal for the Limestone Line and the spur
clearance_notes: Highest platform on the network, so westbound cabins leave on a descending run.
Two arriving cables enter from the west on separate bays of the same platform.
